politifact_headline: Animals aren’t fleeing Yellowstone National Park
politifact_subheadline: If you saw social media posts saying animals are leaving Yellowstone National Park in droves for mysterious reasons, don’t be fooled. A Yellowstone spokesperson said the claim isn’t true; footage circulating online is from other events or taken out of context.
